baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired present plurals in يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ join knowers to the addressees' ongoing doing through مَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus branches form a live epistemic circuit: the addressees bring acts into being, and those acts become clear to plural knowers.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear to a knower makes يَعْلَمُونَ an event of disclosure rather than bare possession of data.
Bringing an act into being makes مَا point to produced action as the content disclosed.

changed_reading.before: They are aware of your deeds.
changed_reading.after: What you are actively bringing into being becomes disclosed to a plurality of knowers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The knowledge verb and the conduct verb can meet through the idea of a deed bearing a recognizable quality or trace.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing need not be unmediated cognition: conduct can leave a distinguishing mark, and its good or bad quality can make the actor's doing legible.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points to its bearer supplies a semiotic route by which the doing is known.
Conduct as praise- or blame-bearing deed-quality makes action reveal character rather than remain a neutral event.

changed_reading.before: The knowers receive an abstract list of behaviors.
changed_reading.after: Your conduct is knowable because it bears differentiating traces and evaluable quality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open relative مَا before تَفْعَلُونَ can hold more than a named deed-token.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammatical branch of ف ع ل opens the known object into an action-envelope containing object, cause, circumstance, place, or event, while ع ل م keeps that envelope apprehensible as a whole.

activation_trace.role: Grammatical objects and complements widen مَا تَفْعَلُونَ from a deed label to the participants and circumstances of doing.
Apprehension of a thing as clear lets the entire action-envelope, not only its surface motion, be the known object.

changed_reading.before: They know which isolated acts you perform.
changed_reading.after: They know the full relational and circumstantial field of what you do.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mark-image activated by the opening sky cue meets the focus branch of knowledge-as-mark, while writing later stabilizes such marks into ordered signs; doing becomes self-indexing evidence.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing mark supplies the focus mechanism by which action points beyond itself to actor and quality.
Quality-bearing conduct gives the mark evaluative content rather than making it a neutral identifier.
The split target's visible brand makes a thing recognizable and unexpectedly activates the same mark-to-knowledge mechanism.
Ordered letters turn transient identifying marks into a durable readable sequence.

structural_cues: The sky cue opens the packet, while writers stand immediately before the focus clause.
The non-dominant و س م mapping is retained as an activation, not substituted for the surface sense of sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible-mark, distinguishing-mark, conduct-quality, and ordered-letter images; I infer that acts generate identity-bearing signs which writing stabilizes. The live alternative is that the و س م split target is only remote lexical residue and should remain a material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge of conduct is an invisible mental fact.
changed_reading.after: Conduct emits identifying and evaluative marks that can be recognized and inscribed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence repeatedly breaches containers, disperses contents, releases what was held, and excavates what was buried; this material sequence recasts knowing as the terminus of forced disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Becoming clear to a knower is the epistemic result toward which the contextual breaches are directed.
Brought-into-being acts supply the contents that the disclosure sequence can expose.
Opening and splitting supplies the first breach through enclosure and functions as the onset of disclosure.
Casting a thing in scattered form turns held contents into distributed, inspectable evidence.
A sudden abundant outflow supplies release under pressure and intensifies disclosure from passive showing to eruption.
Turning soil and uncovering the buried gives the sequence its most explicit excavation image.

structural_cues: 82:1-4 repeat conditional openings and passive reversals before the focus's active knowing.
The sequence moves from the upper enclosure through dispersed lights and waters to buried human remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breach, scattering, outflow, and excavation; I supply the arrow from material exposure to epistemic disclosure of acts. A live alternative is that these ruptures establish only the time of reckoning while the knowers already know independently of them.

changed_reading.before: The knowers continuously observe deeds without any disclosure event.
changed_reading.after: Your acts are contents that no enclosure can finally keep from becoming clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact knowing-plus-MA echo shifts from plural external knowers to the self itself and sorts action along forward and deferred directions, extending the focus beyond present motions into temporal placement and aftereffect.

activation_trace.role: The focus's becoming-clear image supplies external knowing that the earlier self-knowing clause mirrors.
Bringing acts into being provides what can be projected forward or left to a later position.
The same disclosure branch, now predicated of a self, turns external witness into eventual reflexive recognition.
The very self or identity supplies the subject that finally encounters its own action-history.
Advancing forward gives action a projected temporal direction and a possible downstream reach.
Deferral to a later time adds delayed, withheld, or trailing action to what becomes known.

structural_cues: 82:5 and 82:12 share ع ل م followed by مَا and an action verb.
The subject changes from an indefinite self to plural knowers, allowing self-revelation and witnessed knowledge to coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selfhood and forward/later directions; I infer that doing includes projected consequences and deferred omissions, not only clock-time categories. The alternative is a narrower ledger containing two simple classes of completed deeds.

changed_reading.before: They know only what you are doing at the observed moment.
changed_reading.after: They know an action-history extending through what you launch forward and what you leave delayed, a history the self will itself recognize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee is nurtured, measured, completed, set into balance, and composed before being named as a doer; human action is real production by an agent whose capacity and form are themselves produced.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being preserves genuine human doing rather than reducing it to appearance.
Clear apprehension attaches accountability to the formed agent's actual productions.
Repair, nurture, and completion supplies the developmental condition from which the doer emerges.
Measuring and proportioning makes the agent's capacities priorly determined rather than self-originating.
Integrity and completion in the self supplies a coherent platform capable of action.
Setting a thing upright and balanced supplies functional alignment to the embodied doer.
Inserting one thing into another supplies composition: the acting subject is an assembled system.

structural_cues: A chain of perfect verbs with second-person object suffixes in 82:7-8 precedes the second-person plural subject of تَفْعَلُونَ.
The grammatical role reverses from the human as formed object to the human as acting subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, measure, completion, balance, and composition; I infer that these enable the later doing while leaving that doing attributable to the addressee. The alternative is to read the formation sequence only as a gratitude claim with no account of agency.

changed_reading.before: You are autonomous first causes of deeds which others inspect.
changed_reading.after: You genuinely bring acts about, but as formed and enabled agents rather than self-originating makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nurturing lordship, repeated nobility, protective custody, and enrollment frame the plural knowers as entrusted witnesses; the gaze is ethically qualified without losing its accountability function.

activation_trace.role: Clear knowing is the capacity whose social character changes when its bearers are framed as honorable custodians.
Nurture, repair, and completion place the observation system within formative care.
Honor and praiseworthy generosity qualify the Lord whose relation frames the later witnesses.
The repeated honor branch transfers an ethical reliability marker to the writers immediately before يَعْلَمُونَ.
Safeguarding sanctity and covenant makes their watching a trust with protected boundaries, not merely exposure.
Entering a name into a register gives custodianship a responsibility for accurate attribution.

structural_cues: ك ر م qualifies the Lord in 82:6 and the writers in 82:11.
The linked participles حَافِظِينَ and كَاتِبِينَ supply the nearest plural antecedent for يَعْلَمُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formative care, honor, safeguarding, and enrollment; I infer an entrusted and non-predatory witness relation. The alternative is that honor marks only rank or testimonial reliability and does not soften the affective force of surveillance.

changed_reading.before: Anonymous watchers scrutinize you from a hostile distance.
changed_reading.after: Honorable custodians know your doing under an entrusted duty to preserve and attribute it truthfully.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence builds an evidence architecture: reckoning gives stakes, guarding retains events, joining and ordering signs makes a text, and inscription gives the retained action binding status.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing trace supplies the smallest evidentiary unit from which the action can be recognized.
Each brought-about act supplies an event for preservation and inscription.
Accounting and recompense supply the adjudicative use for the preserved knowledge.
Watching and guarding supplies continuous custody of the event before it can disappear.
A preserved thing remaining fixed in awareness supplies retention between occurrence and record.
Joining one item to another turns separate deed-traces into a cumulative ledger.
Ordered letters and the written object make the retained traces readable and transmissible.
Inscription that establishes judgment or determination gives the ledger consequential force.

structural_cues: 82:9-12 proceeds from denial of reckoning to guardians, writers, and finally their knowledge of doing.
The plural participles in 82:10-11 resolve the otherwise unnamed plural subject of 82:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting, custody, retention, joined signs, ordered writing, and binding inscription; I infer the process event-to-trace-to-ledger-to-adjudication. A live alternative is that writing merely reports knowledge already complete and does not mediate it.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts private awareness in the minds of observers.
changed_reading.after: The verse closes a chain in which action becomes preserved, organized, readable, and answerable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, truth-bearing and boundary-breaking conduct sort into contrasting conditions of ease and burning contact, and nonabsence makes the latter inescapably inhabited; known deeds appear world-forming rather than archival only.

activation_trace.role: Conduct with praise- or blame-bearing quality supplies the differentiating input to the two outcome conditions.
Clear knowledge supplies the recognition by which conduct and its fitting trajectory remain joined.
Truth that carries through speech and action supplies one durable mode of conduct.
Good condition and favor supplies an inhabitable state corresponding to that conduct.
Deviation from truth by breaching a covering supplies the contrary conduct as a violated boundary.
Blazing fire and severe heat supplies the contrary condition as a material environment.
Meeting fire and its heat converts an assigned destination into bodily contact.
Concealment from sight supplies the negated escape: the actor cannot become absent from the condition.

structural_cues: 82:13 and 82:14 are parallel nominal clauses pairing person-types with encompassing conditions.
82:15-16 shifts from being in a condition to contact with it and negates absence from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conduct-types, contrasting conditions, heat-contact, and negated absence; I infer that repeated action forms a trajectory one eventually inhabits. The live alternative is a purely external reward-and-penalty relation with no constitutive link between deed and habitat.

changed_reading.before: Known deeds remain entries stored for later lookup.
changed_reading.after: Known conduct builds a trajectory that resolves into an encompassing condition the actor experiences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The guardians' direct present knowing of human action is followed by doubled questions about what could make the human grasp the severe day of account; agency is transparent to witnesses while its final horizon exceeds the agent.

activation_trace.role: A thing already clear to plural knowers supplies one side of the unequal distribution of knowledge.
The non-dominant mapped branch of knowing supplies the first challenge to the addressee's grasp.
Repetition of the same knowing image keeps human non-grasp active rather than resolving it after one question.
The event and severity of the day supplies the opaque object the human cannot independently encompass.
Accounting and recompense identifies that opaque horizon as the adjudication of the already known acts.

structural_cues: The declarative يَعْلَمُونَ is followed later by two nearly identical interrogatives built on أَدْرَىٰ.
The grammatical knower changes from third-person plural witnesses to an addressed human whose knowledge requires an external disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct knowing, repeated challenged knowing, a severe day, and account; I infer an asymmetry between the legibility of human acts and the human's inability to master their final horizon. The alternative is that the doubled question merely magnifies the day without contrasting knower-positions.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports one isolated fact about what the observers know.
changed_reading.after: Your doing is fully legible from the witness side even while the event that settles its account remains beyond your unaided grasp.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close distinguishes enactment from disposal: people truly do what is known, yet no self owns effective control for another, and the final affair belongs to divine authority.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being preserves attributable agency on the human side of the distinction.
Clear knowledge fixes attribution even when control over the outcome is denied.
The very self or identity, repeated in a self-for-self relation, supplies distinct accountable parties.
Ownership and power of disposal supplies precisely the capacity negated between selves.
The affair or state supplies the final domain whose disposal is removed from human possession.
Authority and its holder supplies the positive counterpart to the negated human control.
The worshipped deity identifies where final authority rests rather than leaving it ownerless.

structural_cues: The focus predicates doing of humans, while 82:19 negates one self's possession for another.
The closing clause relocates the affair to God instead of negating that humans performed the recorded acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human doing, distinct selves, negated ownership, affair, authority, and deity; I infer a distinction between causal participation and sovereign disposal. The alternative is narrower: 82:19 may deny only intercession while leaving the metaphysics of ordinary agency unstated.

changed_reading.before: Because you do an act, you possess its efficacy and can control its final disposition.
changed_reading.after: Your doing is real and answerable, but neither it nor another self gives you ownership of the final outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The form-distant mutual-action branch of the focus becomes newly useful when the close pairs self with self and then denies transfer of disposal: the known object can be an interpersonal deed-relation whose history remains even when leverage between parties ends.

activation_trace.role: Mutual action between two supplies a relational, rather than atomized, model of what the plural addressees do.
Clear apprehension makes the relation between actors, not only each isolated motion, available to knowledge.
The repeated very-self image supplies two irreducible endpoints of an interpersonal relation.
Negated ownership and disposal blocks one endpoint from taking control of the other while leaving their prior relations attributable.

structural_cues: The focus has plural knowers and plural doers, and 82:19 explicitly stages one self in relation to another self.
The reciprocal activation comes from a nominal branch of ف ع ل and is therefore carried as form-distant rather than imposed as the verb's direct morphology.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual-action imagery, paired selves, and denied disposal; I infer that the record can preserve relations such as help, injury, or obligation between persons. The live alternative is that ordinary تَفْعَلُونَ has no reciprocal force and simply aggregates individual deeds.

changed_reading.before: Each person's deed is an isolated item in an individual ledger.
changed_reading.after: What is known can include the graph of actions between persons, even though no person finally controls another's disposition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's non-dominant ء ب و target, supported by only the packet's split mapping, and turns doing into parent-like production. It remains anchored to the exact ف ع ل occurrence and gains a second packet-backed nurture image from ر ب ب. Downstream prose should present it only as an abductive analogy for acts that are generated, reared, and outlive the moment, never as the lexical gloss of تَفْعَلُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence of ف ع ل carries both the ordinary bringing-about branch and the packet-provided non-dominant fatherhood/nurture mapping.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being supplies the stable focus anchor for treating deeds as produced entities.
The split target's fatherhood and parental nurture recasts a produced act as something generated and reared by its actor.
Repair, nurture, and completion supplies a contextual process by which what is generated acquires a developed afterlife.

changed_reading.before: An act vanishes once its performance ends.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, an act is something the actor begets and develops, so its consequences remain identifiable as its maker's issue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a rare water branch of focus ع ل م to bursting seas and the dominant د ر ر target behind the later د ر ي cue; the chain is homonymic and cross-domain. It remains valid as a packet-resolved material model anchored in the focus branch and repeated release imagery. Downstream prose should call it a hydraulic analogy for accumulation and disclosure, not claim that يَعْلَمُونَ literally means storing water or that أَدْرَىٰ literally means pouring.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory itself gives ع ل م an image of a large gathered body of water, allowing knowing to be modeled materially as accumulation.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies the reservoir image for cumulative knowing.
Abundant expansive water gives the contextual reservoir a cosmic scale.
Sudden abundant outflow converts stored volume into an event of irresistible disclosure.
The split target's copious flow from a source extends the analogy from gathered knowledge to knowledge released.

changed_reading.before: Knowing is a static, dimensionless mental possession.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, acts accumulate into a reservoir of knowledge whose eventual release overwhelms concealment.

strongest_changes: The rupture sequence turns knowing from static awareness into the eventual unsealing of every acted content.
The mark, custody, and writing branches turn deeds into durable, organized, adjudicable evidence.
Formation before the focus and denied ownership after it bracket human doing as real and attributable but neither self-originating nor sovereign over outcomes.
The repeated later challenge to human knowing creates an asymmetry: deeds are transparent to witnesses while their final horizon exceeds the doer.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained material, semiotic, temporal, social, legal, and agency-centered readings at once. Non-dominant mappings did real abductive work: و س م sharpened action-as-mark, د ر ي contrasted kinds of knowing, and ء ب و preserved the contained image of acts as offspring rather than being silently discarded.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the non-dominant و س م activation should shape the opening sky cue or remain only an analogical echo.
Whether preservation and writing mediate the knowers' knowledge or merely externalize knowledge already complete.
Whether the post-focus conditions are constituted by accumulated conduct or externally assigned as recompense.
The reciprocal, parental, and hydraulic readings are packet-anchored but morphologically or mapping-distant and must remain explicitly exploratory.
